handoff: No blocking findings, so approved. On HEAD 8e480fdb9 the type check is green, and unit 1104/0, integration 372/0 and e2e 72/0 pass. The unit guard passes 114/0 on cli unit. Both review#2 blockers are fixed: the hints now name bun run test:e2e and the test/e2e paths, and B16 exempts only its own file. Minor points for the PR: the new AC7 hint rule was not asked for; golden refuses files outside the tiers; temp dirs leak in the B16 fixture and in herdr-plugin nextToast; the tier lookup is duplicated in golden.ts; F36's cause is still unknown, so the diagnostics need a follow-up. Plus several nits.

findings.title: New AC7 hint repo rule not asked for
findings.detail:
The rule that test code must not tell people to rewrite with plain `bun test` is not in S1's rule list. It guards the review#2 fix and is harmless.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name it as an addition in the PR.

findings.title: golden now refuses a named file outside the tiers
findings.detail:
`bun scripts/golden.ts <file>` now exits 1 for any file outside cli integration and test/e2e. Before, it accepted any file.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: One line in the PR.

findings.title: B16 fixture temp dir never removed
findings.detail:
`mkdtempSync(norn-pinned-)` is never cleaned up. The same holds for `nextToast` in packages/cli/test/integration/herdr-plugin.test.ts:22, which moved here with the leak already in it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Remove them with rmSync in a finally block.

findings.title: Tier lookup duplicated
findings.detail:
`add()` and `harvestCommand` both run the HARVEST_TIERS startsWith test and build the same message.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Extract a `tierOf(file)` that both call.

findings.title: F36 cause still unknown; diagnostics kept
findings.detail:
The failure did not reproduce in this run either (integration 372/0).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say so in the PR and file a follow-up to remove baseDiagnostics once the cause is found.

findings.title: Glob lets through 'in*' folders
findings.detail:
`{[!i]*,i[!n]*}` would select a test/inner/ folder. Today B5's selection rule would turn red if one appeared.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Known; leave it or tighten it.

findings.title: B16 skips test/support/*.test.ts and scripts/*.test.ts
findings.detail:
A test file placed in test/support, or a script test, may import the helpers unflagged.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Closes with slice 05, or filter .test.ts under support.

findings.title: Harvest output named by basename
findings.detail:
Files with the same name in two tiers would write into the same NORN_GOLDEN_OUT folder. None exist today.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Name the folder by the repo-relative path.

findings.title: Header copied from the integration file
findings.detail:
The header describes the segment line and token, but the file tests only planWorkspaceMoves.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Describe the planner.

findings.title: baseDiagnostics: key `n` and a 250-character line
findings.detail:
A mysterious name in the diagnostic output.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Rename it to name, and break the line.
